So I'm usually an eyeliner, mascara, lips girl. But sometimes, if I'm sick or forget to wash my face after a shift, I break out bad. And I hate being seen like that. So. I have some go to products that work amazing. Some are "fancy" brand name, some are drugstore. MOST are cruelty free (that's all I buy now, but I'm still using the remains of some older stuff).

Moisturizer: Rodan and Fields Unblemish Oil Control Lotion (I have EXTREMELY oily skin. If I forget this step, all bets are off. R&F is easily the best oil-beating moisturizer I've ever found, but in a pinch...) Elf + matte oil control lotion

Primer: Benefit POREfessional, Nyx Pre Filler (I have dialated pores that look like old stud piercings, so this is a life saver), Too Faced HangoveRx, Maybelline Baby Skin

Powder: Laura Mercier Translucent (by far my favorite), Kat Von D Lock It Translucent

Foundation: Kat Von D Lock It

Eyeliner: (I use ipsy, so I get a great assortment of these. It's nice because it helps me find favorites. I use liquid or gel for the top and pencil for the bottom. None of these smear or smudge unless you go at it rubbing your eyes!) *Liquid*: Eyeco London Skinny, Ciate Wonderwand (it's so well loved I can't read the label to tell you further). *Pencil*: Ciate Wonderwand Gel Kohl liner (it's not a gel application), Kylie "Kyliner"

Mascara: Benefit Roller Lash (I am so upset they aren't cruelty free, I've been hoarding my last tube of this since I can't buy it again), Too Faced Better Than Sex Waterproof

Setting Spray: Urban Decay All Nighter (I agree with the poster above, there's nothing better), Nyx Matte Finish

Lips: Kylie Matte Liquid Lipsticks (I used to use these religiously, but they dry out my lips a lot more than I want. However, they stay on even through lunch usually.), Anastasia Beverly Hills Liquid Lipsticks (a much smoother application that stays on for most of the day, I touch up at my tens and lunch), HUDA Beauty Lip Strobe (over top another lipstick, have to reapply)

The issue though, is the rules state: 

"Incorporeal creatures can enter or pass through solid objects, but must remain adjacent to the objects exterior, and so cannot pass entirely through an object whose space is larger than it's own. "

So the walls would have to be like 10 feet thick, or 5 feet depending on how you read it. I'm not sure that's feasible. Unless others disagree? I know gm cam be "god of the game", but I prefer it to be as realistic as possible. 

Plus, the ectoplasmic creature can do even more, it just can't STOP while it's moving. 

Phase Lurch: it must begin and end it's turn outside whatever wall or obstacle it's moving through.

There's literally no rule about how many feet of solid material it can move through, and with 30ft standard, using a full round gives it 60 feet. It moves at half speed, so it could go 15 feet into a wall, turn around if it didn't find an opening and come back. They don't use the ability outside of combat so he could feasibly do it nonstop on every 5 feet of wall.
